+"""Camera guided Panda cube pick and orientation placement, one live episode.
+
+Runs one named phase at a time for inspection, or all phases in sequence.  The
+only external state used is the Robot client's calibrated images, proprioception,
+and task target.  No simulator model or object state is accessed.

+

+from scipy.ndimage import label
+from scipy.optimize import least_squares

+

+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+LOG = OUT / "trajectory"
+LO = np.array([-2.8973, -1.7628, -2.8973, -3.0718, -2.8973, -0.0175, -2.8973])
+HI = np.array([2.8973, 1.7628, 2.8973, -0.0698, 2.8973, 3.7525, 2.8973])
+A = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0825, -0.0825, 0.0, 0.088])
+D = np.array([0.333, 0.0, 0.316, 0.0, 0.384, 0.0, 0.0])
+AL = np.array([0.0, -np.pi / 2, np.pi / 2, np.pi / 2, -np.pi / 2, np.pi / 2, np.pi / 2])
+R_GRASP = Rotation.from_euler("x", 180, degrees=True).as_matrix()
+
+
+def fk(q):
+    """Panda modified DH, world base to link 7."""
+    T = np.eye(4)
+    for i in range(7):
+        c, s = np.cos(q[i]), np.sin(q[i])
+        ca, sa = np.cos(AL[i]), np.sin(AL[i])
+        T = T @ np.array([
+            [c, -s, 0, A[i]],
+            [s * ca, c * ca, -sa, -D[i] * sa],
+            [s * sa, c * sa, ca, D[i] * ca],
+            [0, 0, 0, 1],

+def ik(pos, rot, seed):
+    seed = np.clip(np.asarray(seed, float), LO + 0.002, HI - 0.002)

+        return np.r_[12 * (T[:3, 3] - pos), 2.5 * er, 0.012 * (q - seed)]

+    ep = np.linalg.norm(T[:3, 3] - pos)
+    er = np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(rot @ T[:3, :3].T).as_rotvec())
